title: Queue (ring buffer) on textures — dequeue pass
notes: single-row ring buffer; atomic CAS on head; dequeue results packed into row 0 of dequeue_out; enqueue pass can be a sister node using CAS on tail

title: Realtime denoiser (Bilateral + Temporal EMA, ping-pong)
notes: single-pass bilateral + EMA; ping-pong by swapping prev_denoised_tex with next_prev_tex each frame; tune sigma_s in pixels, sigma_r in normalized intensity

title: Queue (ring buffer) on textures — enqueue pass
notes: CAS on tail; treat queue full when wrap(tail+1)==head; source row index is lane; mask helps CI check how many lanes enqueued

title: Tiny job scheduler (dequeue + atomic per-job counters)
notes: SchedulerParams.num_counters sets the counter table size; counters are atomic u32 in a storage buffer; processed_ids_out helps CI assert consumption.
